frequency_question: How frequently has Congress successfully blocked a submitted 123 agreement via joint resolution of disapproval within the statutory review period?
membership_rule: Includes all formal 123 agreements submitted by the executive branch to Congress for review. Excludes purely civilian commercial contracts without intergovernmental agreements.
window: 280 days (covering the typical 90-day continuous session statutory review window and potential veto override timelines)
provenance_note: rate of 0% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 named; these represent the major modern contentious nuclear agreements subject to the statutory review mechanism.
known_gaps: Excludes minor technical amendments or peaceful use extensions that did not trigger major legislative showdowns.
skeleton: Total submitted 123 agreements requiring congressional review since the modern review framework was established.
multiplier: 3 observed formal high-stakes submissions with active congressional review periods / 3 misses = 0/3 hits
validity_reason: The statutory framework under the Atomic Energy Act governing congressional review of 123 agreements remains stable across administrations.
